maddeler.e:
أختنق (form VIII)
# أَخْتَنِقُ (ʔaḵtaniqu) /ʔax.ta.ni.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَنَقَ (iḵtanaqa)
# أَخْتَنِقَ (ʔaḵtaniqa) /ʔax.ta.ni.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَنَقَ (iḵtanaqa)
# أَخْتَنِقْ (ʔaḵtaniq) /ʔax.ta.niq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِخْتَنَقَ (iḵtanaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
